description: Microsoft Monetize conversion pixels on exact /px routes. Covers existing conversion fields plus opaque seg_code and its conditionally required member. Published combined conversion/segment examples omit t; submitted t values remain checked as 1 or 2. Server-side /sspx is vendor/xandr-sspx. Segment /seg and external conversion-code wire formats are outside this profile.

params.name: id
params.description: Conversion pixel ID in the documented ID-based /px profile. The published mixed seg_code examples retain this conversion ID; a segment code does not replace it.
params.fix_hint: Set id to the conversion pixel ID from Monetize.

params.name: t
params.description: Pixel type when supplied: 1 for JavaScript or 2 for an image. Microsoft publishes combined conversion/segment /px examples that omit this setting.
params.fix_hint: When supplying t, use 1 for JavaScript or 2 for an image pixel. Follow the generated tag for the intended rendering mode.

params.name: order_id
params.description: It is an order ID or SKU. Microsoft documents letters and numbers, with a 36 character limit.
params.fix_hint: Set order_id to the order or SKU, letters and numbers only, at most 36 characters.

params.name: value
params.description: It is the dynamic revenue. Microsoft documents a purely numerical value, so 10 is valid and $10 is not.
params.fix_hint: Set value to a number with no currency symbol, such as 10 or 10.50.

params.name: consent
params.description: It is binary consent when TCF signals are not available. Microsoft documents 1 for granted and 0 for denied.
params.fix_hint: Send consent=1 when the user granted consent, or consent=0 when they denied it.

params.name: other
params.description: It is extra external data on the conversion. Microsoft documents letters and numbers, with a 20 character limit.
params.fix_hint: Set other to letters and numbers only, at most 20 characters.

params.name: redir
params.description: It is a piggyback pixel URL. Microsoft documents redir as the image or JavaScript pixel to notify after conversion.
params.fix_hint: Set redir to an absolute image or JavaScript pixel URL, matching the host pixel type.

params.name: seg
params.description: It adds the user to one or more segments when the conversion fires. Microsoft documents comma-separated segment IDs on the same conversion pixel.
params.fix_hint: Set `seg` to one or more integer segment IDs, comma-separated, such as `12192,12304`.

params.name: remove
params.description: It removes the user from one or more segments when the conversion fires. Microsoft documents comma-separated segment IDs on the same conversion pixel.
params.fix_hint: Set `remove` to one or more integer segment IDs, comma-separated, such as `23145`.

params.name: seg_code
params.description: Configured segment code for the documented combined conversion/segment /px call. Preserve its case and punctuation.
params.fix_hint: Supply the configured segment code and its owning member, or omit seg_code when not using a code.

params.name: member
params.description: Member that owns the segment code. Required when seg_code is populated. Its format and account validity remain external.
params.fix_hint: When seg_code is populated, include the member that owns that segment code.
